findings.text: The docstring of `FIXTURE_COMPILED_MODULES` says "the old fixture" without naming that fixture, and its last sentence ("handwritten tests submit changed records that these fixture omissions would hide") does not clearly say why the fixture omits modules that `export_bundle` exports, or why the hostile tests need handwritten records. Fix: Write short active sentences: the kernel fixture compiles these four modules as protected inputs, so the attack export omits them; production preparation exports `SqlInputs` and omits only `trusted_imports | {PROTECTED_BASE_MODULE}`; so the attack tests submit handwritten records for the changes that this export cannot contain.
